title: Whole ordered Schur normal form for the H=1 primary component
body:
This enabling proof gives an explicit normal form for the entire ordered Schur residual when I-H is nilpotent. It proves exact sector-capacity conditions and removes all sector00 factor data by an explicit coordinate map, even when the original splits are inequivalent. The sharp-sector criterion remains a cited premise. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c7650ef0ebf845f8f920c4892fdbbfe2e0bf95b/research/unipotent-ordered-schur/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c7650ef0ebf845f8f920c4892fdbbfe2e0bf95b/research/unipotent-ordered-schur/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c7650ef0ebf845f8f920c4892fdbbfe2e0bf95b/research/unipotent-ordered-schur/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c7650ef0ebf845f8f920c4892fdbbfe2e0bf95b/research/unipotent-ordered-schur/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 2,577 candidate factor pairs, 360 complete-domain residual intertwiners, 11 padded basis changes, 16 higher-block fixtures and five controls. Both print `PASS_UNIPOTENT_ORDERED_SCHUR`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/unipotent-ordered-schur
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted CI has not yet been checked. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Prove a source-bound general-H gluing statement before using primary-component normal forms to identify arbitrary ordered residual states. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit ssafwann's [PR #5267](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5267) supplies the nilpotent-H comparison, exact sector equations and explicit full-rank extension specialization in its [proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8ab280c8a3ef0544f13ff23a1c69df4757cd4900/research/schur-nilpotent-extension/README.md). MatShep's [PR #4762](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4762) supplies the arbitrary factor-system extension and realizability theorem in its [proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3b4e0449262b0b1e07b80e009ef71cc0ca5bf816/research/idempotent-factor-invariant/README.md), extending codyw912's argument. Nick Petalas's [PR #4746](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4746) sharp-sector criterion is used in exactly the form stated and credited in the pinned nilpotent proof. Ali Romman's [PR #5287](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5287) already determines the whole central class in its [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d17a8b3d237a8cb8685cc108bf2bb17dfea0ca78/research/schur-whole-central-class/PROOF.md); it leaves the ordered pair open. The broader Schur and normalizer lineage retains its source credit. Basis extension and nilpotent Jordan methods are classical.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
